snippet.title: The Making of Nocturnals | Indie Game Development
snippet.description:
Take a look behind the scenes of my passion project, Nocturnals, featuring concept art, cut content and more. I will be answering questions about why the project was created, the challenges I faced during development, as well as information on what's next for Cowboy Toad Games.

Check out Nocturnals on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578910/Nocturnals/


00:00 - Introduction
00:36 - My Goal
03:34 - Background Info
05:11 - Early Development
08:08 - Cut Content
09:14 - Constraints During Development
10:59 - Concept Art & Rough Sketches
12:19 - The Future


Follow Cowboy Toad Games:
